# archestra_knowledge_directory (Resource)

Named directory for uploaded knowledge files. Destroy deletes the directory and moves its files to the repository root.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_knowledge_directory" "example" {
  name = "Platform guides"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `file_count` (Number) File count.
- `id` (String) Id.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization id.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
- `visibility` (String) Visibility.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_knowledge_directory.example directory_uuid
```
